headline: Baltic Dry Index Rebounds 3.5% Driven by Capesize Vessel Gains
summary: The Baltic Exchange's dry bulk freight index rose 3.5% to 3,000 points, ending a two-day decline as the Capesize shipping segment jumped 6.2%.
why: The Baltic Dry Index tracks global ocean transport rates for major bulk commodities including iron ore, coal, and grains.

impacts.name: Baltic Dry Index
impacts.why: The index rebounded 3.5% on higher Capesize spot charter rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Increased demand for 150,000-ton Capesize cargoes carrying iron ore and coal drove dry bulk freight benchmarks higher.
